steps.text: Turn on your espresso coffee machine to allow it to heat up the water.
steps.label: heat espresso machine

steps.text: Clean and Dry Portafilter & Basket. Before making a coffee with the espresso machine make sure that your portafilter & basket are both clean and dry.
steps.label: dry portafilter

steps.text: Dose your ground coffee into the portafilter.
steps.label: dose ground coffee

steps.text: Using a coffee tamper, tamp your coffee. Then apply a light amount of pressure to compact your coffee.
steps.label: tamp the coffee

steps.text: Add the boiling water from the kettle
steps.label: top with hot water
